You are responsible for picking and preparing orders for shipment according to customer specifications. You ensure that the right products, in the right quantities and of the right quality, are picked and prepared for transport. You work at a fast pace and pay close attention to detail to prevent errors. 
Your duties include: - Collecting products based on order lists or handheld scanners. - Checking the quality and quantity of the products. - Packing and labeling products according to established guidelines. - Preparing orders for shipment. - Identifying and reporting any deviations or damages to the team leader. - Contributing to a safe and organized working environment. - Occasionally assisting in other logistics processes, such as loading and unloading trucks.

The company you will be working for (a timber trade) has grown from a local supplier of wood and sheet materials into an international enterprise with a strong position in the DIY and construction sectors.
